**Finding: compliant (preferred position).**

The agreement affirmatively negates any minimum purchase commitment:

- **§ 2.1 (p0013)** — "No minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies. Customer pays only for Services ordered in a mutually executed Order Form, and its decision not to enter another Order Form is not a breach or shortfall." This satisfies both preferred elements directly.
- **§ 7.1 (p0026)** — Vendor may not impose a "minimum-use, or similar charge" not identified in the Order Form, closing the back-door route to a commitment.
- **§ 12.3 (p0051)** — Vendor acknowledges Customer has made no "minimum-volume" commitment.
- **§ 22 (p0095–p0096)** — the only "shortfall" language is an audit true-up for actual over-consumption of licensed quantities, which is not take-or-pay and is not flagged here.
- **§ 8** term/renewal contains no non-cancellable multi-year commitment; Order Form renewals are terminable by Customer on 30 days' notice.

No redline proposed, since we do not upgrade or edit a clause that already sits at the preferred position and benefits us.
